name: ck_ai_conversation_items_content
expression: message_type::text = 'text'::text AND text_content IS NOT NULL AND media_url IS NULL OR (message_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['image'::character varying::text, 'audio'::character varying::text])) AND media_url IS NOT NULL

name: ck_ai_conversation_items_user_buffer
expression: role::text = 'user'::text AND buffer_id IS NOT NULL OR role::text <> 'user'::text

name: ck_wake_delay_state
expression: aggregate_state = 0 AND wake_delay_ms IS NOT NULL OR aggregate_state <> 0 AND wake_delay_ms IS NULL

name: idx_ai_message_buffer_macro
expression: macro_expires_at_ms WHERE ((aggregate_state = 1) AND (macro_expires_at_ms IS NOT NULL))

name: idx_ai_message_buffer_micro
expression: micro_expires_at_ms WHERE ((aggregate_state = 1) AND (micro_expires_at_ms IS NOT NULL))

name: ck_message_endpoints_scope_device
expression: endpoint_scope = 1 AND device_id IS NULL OR endpoint_scope = 2 AND device_id IS NOT NULL

name: ck_square_categories_theme_key
expression: theme_key::text = ANY (ARRAY['blue'::character varying, 'cyan'::character varying, 'teal'::character varying, 'green'::character varying, 'lime'::character varying, 'yellow'::character varying, 'orange'::character varying, 'purple'::character varying, 'pink'::character varying, 'magenta'::character varying, 'beige'::character varying, 'charcoal'::character varying]::text[])

name: ck_users_username_length
expression: username IS NULL OR char_length(username::text) >= 5 AND char_length(username::text) <= 20
